summary: Phase F8.0 SMS/Notification Auto-Sync + Phase F7.7 Shipment Stage Routing verified. Backend 16/16 tests PASS (7 base + 9 extended edge cases: rule count=16, In-Transit whitelist stage, Delivery Import engine parity, already-Delivered/unknown-AWB/wrong-sender guards, GET shipments now exposes booking_date + needs_return_review). Frontend: Dashboard loads, Shipments tab shows In Transit + Out for Delivery filter chips (F7.7 stage tabs), 27 OFD items render Last Event category badges, /courier-sync page renders without crash. CRITICAL BUG FIXED: /app/frontend/app/shipment-details/[id].tsx referenced CourierSyncListener without importing it → ReferenceError red-screen every time a shipment card was opened on web. Added the missing default import. After fix, shipment detail page loads cleanly (no ErrorBoundary, no console CourierSyncListener errors). Deprecated shadow* style warnings noted (non-blocking).

rca_of_issue: Root cause of red-screen crash: /app/frontend/app/shipment-details/[id].tsx line 189 called `CourierSyncListener.addIngestResultListener(...)` inside a useEffect (Phase F8.0 wiring) but the file was missing `import CourierSyncListener from '../../modules/courier-sync-listener'`. On Android the native module symbol may have leaked via bundler; on web (Metro strict scoping) the variable was undefined → ReferenceError caught by ErrorBoundary. Reproduction: log in as admin → Shipments → open any shipment card → red-screen. Mitigation: added the import (same path other files use). Verified: shipment-details now renders correctly, console shows no CourierSyncListener / ReferenceError / ErrorBoundary messages.
